subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this TUI issue be completed as docs/help for the existing pi-tui newline behavior, or should OpenClaw add a configurable TUI send/newline keybinding contract?
rationale: Current main already gets newline insertion from pi-tui, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter behavior would add public TUI config or CLI surface that repository policy treats as product and compatibility sensitive.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved TUI config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with default-compatibility tests and docs.

options.title: Close As Dependency-Satisfied
options.body: Treat dependency-backed newline insertion as sufficient and explicitly decline docs/help/config follow-up.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update TUI docs and `/help` with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings.

likelyOwner.reason: They already framed this exact product choice in the issue discussion and have the strongest TUI dependency-history signal.
